name: Daihatsu Infinearth Mfg.Co.,Ltd
summary: Daihatsu Infinearth Mfg.Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells marine engines, land engines, and industrial instruments in Japan, China, Asia, Central America, South America, North America, and internationally. The company operates through Marine Engine Related and Land Engine Related segments. It offers marine engine products, including propulsion systems, electric propulsion systems, auxiliary systems, and dual-fuel engines, as well as marine engines for nitrogen oxide regulations. The company also provides land diesel engines and gas turbines/gas engines for emergency power generation/pumping; and co-generation systems.
